# Colophon {-}

Written in R Markdown and built with **bookdown** [@R-bookdown]. Typeset in
Inter and JetBrains Mono. Figures use the viridis plasma palette (option `"C"`),
the series convention for this volume.

Interface icons are Font Awesome Free 6.5.1, vendored in `style/webfonts/`
rather than loaded from a content delivery network. The icons are licensed
CC BY 4.0, the fonts under the SIL OFL 1.1, and the accompanying code under the
MIT License; see <https://fontawesome.com/license/free>.

```{r colophon-session, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE}
sessioninfo::session_info(pkgs = "attached")
```
